title: Just introduced to this sub and my mind is a little blown.
content: Like...how is it possible to be having such nearly identical dreams. And every time I wake up feeling like this was a real place, and it takes me a few minutes after waking up to realize that no...that was entirely too fantastical to be real. Sometimes it feels so real, like it's a memory, but it can't possibly be.Mallworld, for me, is very often connected to a school (although not always). The school I'm in is always far larger and far more....just....MORE then my real highschool ever was. I don't know how to describe it better then that. I always am freaking out because I don't know what my class schedule is and I know I'm going to be in trouble if I'm caught just wandering around while I'm supposed to be in class. I'm lost because this school is just like a labyrinth of never ending giant halls. This is when I slip away to this giant, futuristic mall that's at least partially underground because I'm able to access it from a tunnel from the school. Often my dreams just start inside the mall without the school. But it's always massive, futuristic, and what you might describe as cyberpunk. It's full of not only stores but huge attractions and an aquarium. Neon lights and huge video screens are everywhere. There's also a nightclub. It's often, connected to a hotel I frequently dream about. The hotel is also huge with this incredibly ornate lobby, all gold toned, and has an elevator that can go in any direction....including some tubes that can take you to completely different buildings. I have the airport dream as well, but I don't remember it ever being part of the mall complex. But it's the same airport every time. And every time I get distracted by the massiveness of this airport that is also full of giant restaurants, stores, attractions, and huge fountains....really unlike any real airport. It's a lot like the mall only mostly tan, full of plants, and not futuristic and neon. Then freak out because it's time for my flight and I realize I am so far from the gate that I'm never going to make it because I've wandered too far away. The last place I dream about is a boardwalk. In my head, it's always Coney Island but it is NOTHING like the real Coney Island. Everything there is just so....fantastical. And every time I wake up I also end up feeling....sad? I don't know if that's the right word exactly. But the dream world feels so right, and it's like I'm almost homesick about it.
